title: Character (Payload)
description: A NutriQuest character. Stored as JSON payload inside scan_character.payload and lootbox_drop.payload. Mirrors Swift Character model 1:1.

id.description: Unique character id. Scan-minted: scan-{barcode}. Lootbox: from loot table.

name.description: Display name. From Open Food Facts product_name_en or loot table.

rarity.description: 7-tier superset. Scans mint 4 core tiers (common/rare/epic/legendary). Lootbox uses all 7.

statType.description: Which stat this character primarily boosts. Determines battle element.

isLocked.description: Whether the character is locked in the collection (not yet unlocked).
